model_description: Qwen3.5-4B (text part: 32 layers of width 2,560; layers 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27 and 31 are full-attention layers with 16 query heads and 4 key/value heads of size 256 and a gated output, the other 24 are Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers with 16 key heads and 32 value heads of size 128; each layer has a SwiGLU MLP of width 9,216; RMSNorm; vocabulary 248,320; input embedding and output layer tied). It is larger than the GPU allows at full precision, so the forward-pass tool runs it in 4-bit (NF4); every matrix you edit is kept in bfloat16 there, so your edits are applied exactly. The weights you read in the kernel are the original bfloat16 weights. The vocabulary matrix (248,320 x 2,560) is 2.5 GB in float32: read the rows you need with load_rows(name, rows) instead of load(name)
keep_note: , which stay in bfloat16. Thinking-enabled mode is scored too: your edit should not make it worse.
